content.text: Wɑrɑ u wee Botisirɑn di
ye yɑ wɑ̃ɑ Edɔmun temɔ,
u yɑbe swɑ̃ɑru sebuɑ kom kom.
Mɑ u sĩimɔ kɑ win dɑm kpuro, kɑ toro sindu.
Yinni Gusunɔ u nɛɛ,
nɛnɑ nɑ wee n kɑ siri dee dee.
Nɑ dɑm mɔ n kɑ nɛn tɔmbu fɑɑbɑ ko.
Mbɑn sɔ̃nɑ wunɛn yɑ̃nu nu sɔ̃ri
nɡe wi u resɛm ɡɑmɑmɔ.
U wisɑ u nɛɛ,
nɛ turowɑ nɑ dɑ nɑ tɔmbu tɑɑkɑ nɡe resɛm.
Bwesenu kpuro sɔɔ, bɑɑ tɔn turo u ǹ nɛ u mɑn somi.
Nɑ bu tɑɑkɑ nɑ kɔsukɑ kɑ mɔru,
sere ben yɛm mu nɛn yɑ̃nu wisi nu disinu kuɑ.
Domi nɑ ɡɔ̃ru doke n kɑ mɔru kɔsiɑ.
Tɔ̃rɑ mɑɑ turɑ n kɑ nɛn tɔmbu yɑkiɑ.
Nɑ mɛɛrɑ mɛɛrɑ nɑ biti soorɑ.
Nɑ ǹ wɑ wi u koo mɑn somi.
Goo sɑri wi u koo mɑn dɑm kɛ̃.
Adɑmɑ nɛn mɔru yɑ mɑn dɑm sosiɑ nɑ kɑ nɑsɑrɑ wɑ.
Wee, nɑ tɔmbu tɑɑkɑ kɑ mɔru.
Bɑ burisinɑ nɡe tɑm nɔrobu nɛn mɔrun sɔ̃.
Mɑ nɑ ben yɛm yɑri temɔ.
Kon Yinni Gusunɔn durom mɛ u sun kuɑ kpɑrɑ,
kpɑ n nùn tɔmɑ ye u sun kuɑn sɔ̃.
Kon win tɔn ɡeerun ɡɑri ɡere
te u bɛsɛ Isirelibɑ sɔ̃ɔsi
win wɔnwɔndu kɑ win kĩi bɑkɑrun sɑɑbu.
U bwisikɑ u nɛɛ, sɑ sɑ̃ɑwɑ win tɔmbu,
sɑ ǹ nùn tɔnu kɑndu kuɑmmɛ.
Yen sɔ̃nɑ u sun fɑɑbɑ kuɑ.
Bɛsɛn wɑhɑlɑ kpuro sɔɔ, u sun somi.
N ǹ mɔ win ɡɔrɑdo u sun fɑɑbɑ kuɑ,
win tiiwɑ u sun yɑkiɑ
win kĩru kɑ win wɔnwɔndun sɔ̃.
Mɑ u sun nɔɔri sɑɑ yellun di.
Adɑmɑ sɑ nùn seesi sɑ win Hunde nuki sɑnkɑ.
Yen sɔ̃nɑ u kuɑ bɛsɛn yibɛrɛ
mɑ u kɑ sun tɑbu kuɑ.
Mɑ sɑ Mɔwisin wɑɑti yɑɑyɑ sɑ nɛɛ,
mɑnɑ Yinni Gusunɔ u wɑ̃ɑ
wi u kɑ bɛsɛ kɑ bɛsɛn wiruɡibu nim wɔ̃ku tɔburɑ.
Mɑnɑ u wɑ̃ɑ,
wi u derɑ win Hunde Dɛɛro u wɑ̃ɑ bɛsɛn suunu sɔɔ.
Mɑ u Mɔwisi kpɑrɑ kɑ win dɑm bɑkɑm.
U nim burɑnɑ bɛsɛn wuswɑɑɔ
u n kɑ yĩsi bɛɛrɛɡiru yɑrɑ
sere kɑ bɑɑdommɑɔ.
U sun kpɑrɑ nim bweru sɔɔ.
Mɑ sɑ sĩɑ ɡbɑburɔ
nɡe dumi yi yi duki mɔ̀,
sɑ ǹ sokure.
Win Hunde u kɑ sun dɑ sɑ wɛ̃rɑ
nɡe mɛ yɑ̃ɑ kpɑro u rɑ kɑ win yɑɑ sɑbenu de wɔwɑɔ.
Nɡe mɛyɑ u sun kpɑrɑ u kɑ yĩsi bɛɛrɛɡiru yɑrɑ.
Yinni Gusunɔ,
ɑ mɛɛrimɑ sɑɑ wɔllun di
mi wunɛn wɑ̃ɑ yee dɛɛrɑru kɑ yiikoɡirɑ wɑ̃ɑ,
kpɑ ɑ wɑ ye yɑ sun mɔ̀.
Mɑnɑ wunɛn hɑniɑ kɑ wunɛn dɑm mu wɑ̃ɑ.
Wee ɑ sun wunɛn kĩru kɑ wunɛn wɔnwɔndu wunɑri.
Adɑmɑ wunɑ ɑ sɑ̃ɑ bɛsɛn bɑɑbɑ.
Bɛsɛn yĩiyɔbu kun mɑɑ wɑ̃ɑ bɛsɛn sikɑdobɑ sɔɔ.
Bɑɑ Aburɑhɑmu kɑ Isireli bɑ̀ kun sun wure,
Yinni Gusunɔ, wunɑ ɑ sɑ̃ɑ bɛsɛn bɑɑbɑ,
wunɛ wi ɑ sun fɑɑbɑ kuɑ sɑɑ yellun di.
Yinni Gusunɔ,
mbɑn sɔ̃nɑ ɑ derɑ sɑ kɑ wunɛn swɛɛ tondɑ,
mɑ bɛsɛn ɡɔ̃rusu bɔbiɑ,
sɑ ǹ mɑɑ nun nɑsie.
A wurɑmɑ bɛsɛn kĩrun sɔ̃ bɛsɛ be sɑ nun sɑ̃ɑmɔ.
Sɑ sɑ̃ɑwɑ wunɛɡibu sɑɑ yellun di.
Wee, sɑɑ fiiko tɔnɑwɑ bɛsɛ wunɛn tɔn be ɑ ɡɔsɑ,
sɑ sinɑ tem mɛ sɔɔ.
Mɑ bɛsɛn yibɛrɛbɑ bɑ wunɛn sɑ̃ɑ yeru wɔri bɑ kɔsukɑ.
Wee yɑ tɛ, mìn di sɑ sɑ̃ɑ nɡe be ɑ ǹ kpɑre,
kɑ be bɑ ǹ wunɛn yĩsiru sɔɔwɑ.
Yinni Gusunɔ, sɑ nun mɑrɑ
ɑ wɔllu ɡĩɑ kpɑ ɑ sɑrɑmɑ.
À n tunumɑ, ɡuunu nu koo diiri bɛrum sɔ̃.
